walkthroughs.body_html:
A business plan usually has:

  • Idea and USP.
  • Target market.
  • 4 Ps.
  • Costs, prices, profit forecast.
  • How you'll get the money.

Banks won't lend without one. 🏦

Mission = why we exist today. Innocent: 'make natural, delicious food'.

Vision = where we want to be tomorrow. 'Healthiest brand in Europe.'

Both guide every decision.

Good objectives are SMART:

  • Specific — 'sell 200 cakes'.
  • Measurable — yes/no after.
  • Achievable — possible.
  • Realistic — fits resources.
  • Timed — by 31 July.

'Make money' is NOT a SMART goal. 'Make £1,000 profit by Christmas' is. 🎄

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a stakeholder and a shareholder?
options: Stakeholders and shareholders are different spellings of the same word.
PESTLE stands for Profit, Earnings, Sales, Trade, Loans, Equity.
A shareholder owns shares in the company; a stakeholder is anyone affected by or with interest in the business — employees, customers, suppliers, community, plus shareholders.
Stakeholders are managers and shareholders are workers.
PESTLE stands for Profit, Earnings, Sales, Trade, Loans, Equity.
PESTLE analyses the internal strengths and weaknesses of a business.
Stakeholders are managers and shareholders are workers.
The external macro-environment: Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Legal and Environmental factors affecting a business.

mcqs.q: How is Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) calculated?
options: Stakeholders are managers and shareholders are workers.
ROCE is the wages divided by hours worked.

Operating profit divided by capital employed (total equity + non-current liabilities), expressed as a percentage. It measures how efficiently the business uses its long-term financing to generate profit.
ROCE is just net profit divided by revenue.
